name: docs-for-product-managers-pack
description: 41 Claude Skills for the documents product people write, from the first brief to the post-launch review: a writing style guide, a doc template kit and the six-line doc brief, customer interview guides, user research summaries and competitive analysis, opportunity assessments, the lean, business model and value proposition canvases, problem statements, product one-pagers, PRDs, AI feature specs and eval plans, user stories and acceptance criteria, trade-off and decision memos, the working backwards PR/FAQ and the business case, product strategy, roadmap narratives, product OKRs and the weekly update, metrics reviews, roadmap review pre-reads, QBRs and the board memo, launch plans, sales enablement briefs, release notes, sunset notices, experiment readouts and post-launch reviews, meeting notes, decision logs, team charters, handovers and new-PM onboarding, RFC reviews, executive summaries and the plain language edit. Each skill produces one finished document with a named reader and a length budget.
